dct_title_s: Greene County, Iowa, 1953, aerial photomosaic index
dct_description_sm: Title supplied by cataloger based on information from sheet label. Image is a photoreduction of the mosaic created from original aerial photographs. Designating symbol BZP. Form of individual image numbering: BZP-2M-[number], or BZP-3M-[number]. Date of publication inferred from data on individual photographs within the mosaic. Flown by Aero Exploration Company, Tulsa, Oklahoma. "Approximate scale, 1:20,000" [refers to individual images from which mosaic was made].
